[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[center][size=4]Star Baby Tractor Reskin[/size][/center]
This is a fan‑made non‑profit reskin mod based on Star Baby from Love and Deepspace. Only visual changes, will not affect game balance.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install all prerequisites above
2. Unzip archive into your Stardew Valley /Mods folder
3. Start game via SMAPI

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
‑ Replace tractor body sprite
‑ Replace tractor top‑left buff status icon

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
‑ SMAPI
‑ Content Patcher
‑ Tractor Mod
